title: Gift agreement
paragraphs: Donor: Grant Larceny. Recipient: The Meridian Museum of Art & World Cultures.
1. Naming: The institution shall be renamed The Grant Larceny Meridian Museum.
2. Governance: The donor shall retain approval rights over future acquisitions.
3. Management: Artie Ficial shall tender his resignation within sixty days of acceptance.
annotation: Artie - confirm acceptance before the unveiling. G.L.

title: Shipping manifest / 1988
annotation: Keep with accession papers. Do not substitute exhibition label for ownership file.

title: A warning left behind
paragraphs: RETURN WHAT WAS TAKEN BEFORE THE STAR GOES DARK.

title: GRANT’S NIGHT OF GLORY
paragraphs: Gala programme / press proof. Private toast 6:49. Star Bowl alcove closure 6:48. Unveiling follows the toast.
Printed before the final installation inspection.
Grant Larceny will announce his naming agreement tonight.
annotation: Paige Turner / advance schedule; keep for checking against actual cues.

title: Treatment finding
annotation: Earlier adhesive finding also disputed by donor. Safety takes priority.

title: Donor agreement / margin copy
paragraphs: The proposed permanent gift remains subject to outstanding provenance review. An accession does not remove competing ownership claims.
annotation: Permanent title does not cure disputed title. S.V.

title: Auction result
annotation: E.M. beat G.L. through a proxy. He will never forgive this.

title: Vincent Van Faux
paragraphs: Treasures of the World / Gallery label
annotation: NO. This does not belong in the show.

title: Education reallocation
annotation: Anne E. Dote has not approved these cuts.

title: Donor Salon camera
annotation: Deliberate disconnection. Not a technical fault.

title: Closing reveal / concept
paragraphs: Printed gala credit: The Larceny Foundation.
annotation: The sketch predates the donor’s program credit.

title: Display proposal / superseded
paragraphs: Enclosed-cabinet proposal dated 20 October. Superseded before installation. Retained with the advance gala papers.

title: Clock inspection slip
annotation: Leave mechanism alone during the gala; synchronized clocks remain correct.

title: Cancelled programme cue
stamp: LIGHTING JOB LOG / NOT SECURITY LOG
annotation: Lighting console does not open or close the security curtain.

title: Grant Larceny’s toast
paragraphs: 6:40 — empty private silver coupe delivered to Donor Salon.
6:49 — donor’s private toast. Coupe stays in salon.
annotation: Brie DeVivre / final service instruction after two revisions.
